instruction: Please batch add a 10-pixel white border to all images on the desktop using GIMP automation, rather than adding borders to each image manually.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP lacks reliable batch border addition capabilities in the OSWorld environment. Automated processing to add precise borders across multiple images with verification is not achievable with available tools.

llm_judge_reasons: The task has been correctly classified as infeasible with the appropriate 'infeasible' evaluator function

Available GIMP metrics in the codebase (check_image_size, check_structure_sim, etc.) do not provide border width/color verification capabilities
